title: czeslaw-halinka-dance
description: Bezpośrednia puenta po shocie confusion-techno. W tej samej przyciemnionej sali Czesław wychodzi przed bok stołu komisji i zaczyna tańczyć techno całkowicie sztywno, mechanicznie i z kamienną urzędniczą twarzą, jakby realizował zatwierdzoną procedurę. Halinka pozostaje nieruchoma za stołem, opiera dłonie o jego krawędź i patrzy na niego w kontrolowanym szoku. Migają niebiesko-różowe światła, a para sceniczna płynie przez salę.

prompts.image: Continue directly from confusion-techno with the same AIMFTV ceremony hall, jury table, props, dim blue-magenta strobe lighting and stage fog. Use a wider 16:9 composition. Czesław stands on the open floor beside the table and performs an intensely serious stiff bureaucratic techno dance, one forearm vertical and the other horizontal at a right angle, knees rigid and loose tie moving. Halinka remains motionless behind the table with both hands braced on its edge, watching him in disbelief. Preserve exact identities, wardrobe, AIMFTV logo, Golden Emoji trophy and hall continuity. Exactly two people; only Czesław dances; no Maia, DJ console, audience, confetti, captions or watermark.
prompts.animation:
Static camera. Czesław performs a stiff, awkward, repetitive mechanical techno dance with rigid knees, small side-to-side steps, precise right-angle forearm movements and subtle shoulder bounces. His face remains completely serious and bureaucratic; he never smiles or speaks. His loose tie swings naturally. Halinka stays behind the table almost completely motionless, hands braced on the edge, watching him with stunned disbelief; she does not dance or speak. Blue-magenta strobe light pulses rhythmically and thin stage fog drifts slowly across the floor and background. Preserve both identities, anatomy, wardrobe, table, trophy, props and room. No new people, no camera movement, no cuts, no confetti.
